cbc: CBC is counting the number of white and red blood cells and the number of platelets in 1 cubic millimeter of blood.
CBC means the same as complete blood count or blood profile.
cbr: CBR is the cooled remnant of the hot big bang that fills the entire universe and can be observed today with an average temperature of about 2.725 kelvin.
CBR means the same as cosmic background radiation or cosmic microwave background radiation or CMBR.
